reading.zh: 一期先把 CA 预留字段落全（fields），再定义验签结果状态机与唯一回写通道（verify），最后是二期接入所需的能力开关与协议位（roadmap）。
reading.en: Phase one lands the fields first (fields), then defines the verification result state machine and its single write-back path (verify), and finally the capability switches and protocol slots for phase two (roadmap).
